name: SelfAware
description: SelfAware is a dataset designed to evaluate large language models' self-knowledge by assessing their ability to identify unanswerable or unknowable questions. It contains unanswerable questions from five diverse categories along with their answerable counterparts, enabling analysis of models' uncertainty detection and self-knowledge capabilities.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark for self-knowledge and uncertainty detection that is used in research on model calibration and abstention, but it is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on LLMs' ability to recognize unanswerable questions and their own knowledge limits.
